howToBegin.title: How to begin
howToBegin.description1: Use your phone or a screen recorder to capture a lesson — no studio needed.
howToBegin.description2: Attach the video to a lesson and send it in. Your school admin reviews it before it goes live.
howToBegin.description3: Once approved, your video appears inside the lesson for every enrolled student.
howToBegin.tip1: Keep each video focused on one topic so students can find it easily.
howToBegin.tip2: You'll get a notification the moment it's approved or sent back.
howToBegin.tip3: Replace or update a video any time — students always see the latest version.
howToBegin.helpText1: Upload straight from the propose dialog with a live progress bar; large files stream directly to storage.
howToBegin.helpText2: Admins see every pending video in one review queue, so nothing waits longer than it needs to.
howToBegin.helpText3: Progress and quiz results are tracked automatically as students watch your lesson.

reasons.title: So many reasons to start
reasons.description1: Publish the course you want, in the way you want, and always have control of your own content.
reasons.description2: Teach what you know and help learners explore their interests, gain new skills, and advance their careers.
reasons.description3: Expand your professional network, build your expertise, and earn money on each paid enrollment.
